title: Canonical scalar-extension comparison on Ext-based scheme cohomology
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings, S an R-algebra, X a scheme with f:X→Spec R [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], and M an O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Write H^q(X,M) for the Ext-based cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology], with R-action through R→Γ(X,O_X). Put p:X_S=X×_{Spec R}Spec S→X and f_S:X_S→Spec S. Define HOver(f,M,q) to be that cohomology with this R-action. The inverse-image functor on abelian sheaves maps Ext classes; use the canonical comparison of constant integer sheaves and the map adjoint to M→p_*p^*M to obtain a canonical R-linear map HOver(f,M,q)→HOver(f_S,p^*M,q). Define β^q_{f,M,S}:S⊗_R HOver(f,M,q)→HOver(f_S,p^*M,q) as its S-linear extension, b⊗x↦b·p^*x. No flatness or compactness is assumed. The coefficient maps and cohomology maps are natural for commuting module squares, and their scalar law is H(f,φ)(a·x)=f^♯(a)·H(f,φ)(x). This describes the specifically constructed map H.baseChange, not the existence of an unspecified map.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.5.2 (Tag 02KH), proof, affine-section comparison and canonical base-change map preceding the separated-case paragraph

proof.text: Use [lem-pc-abelian-inverse-image-finite-limits] and [lem-pc-abelian-inverse-image-finite-colimits] to obtain preservation of finite limits and colimits by invImage f, as required by the map on Ext classes. Construct the underlying coefficient map by the sheaf adjunction, and compare the constant integer sheaves using constantSheafsheafPullbackIso.

Build cohomologyModule from a ring representation on an abelian sheaf, using additivity and functoriality of Sheaf.H.map. The ring representation scalarRep sends a global section to its smulHom. Build cohomologyComparisonLinear from Sheaf.H.mapFunctor followed by Sheaf.H.map of the coefficient map; sheafComparison_naturality proves R-linearity for compatible representations. Specialize to the module pullback unit. Cached sheafification and HasExt instances share the cohomology construction; named baseChangedScheme, baseChangeFst, baseChangeSnd, baseChangedModule and baseChangeUnit share the cartesian square and coefficient data without changing them.

Restrict the scalar representations along R→Γ(X,O_X) and S→Γ(X_S,O_X_S). The pullback-square equation and ΓSpecIso naturality identify the R-actions, giving the coefficient compatibility used by H.baseChangeLinear. The generic extendComparison uses TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lift to extend that linear map to H.baseChange, sending b⊗x to b times its cohomology pullback. HOver is a type synonym of Modules.H retaining the displayed structure morphism. Its additive group directly reuses instAddCommGroupH and its scalar module directly reuses moduleH restricted along the displayed morphism, without copying either into expanded fields. The generic scalar-representation action agrees definitionally with that action. The unneeded H.fmap and H.fmap_smul helpers are absent.
